title: Input Data and Indicator Estimates from the WHO/UNICEF Joint Monitoring Programme
text: goal jmpinput make data behind /UNICEF Joint Monitoring Programme Water Supply, Sanitation Hygiene (JMP) available tidy, documented R datasets. package contains two data resources JMP 2025 release, prepared update pipeline documented data-raw/UPDATING.md: jmpraw: survey-level input data sanitation underlies JMP estimates, extracted country files published washdata.org. jmpindicators: modelled JMP indicator estimates drinking water, sanitation hygiene JMP world file, variable codes normalized legacy JMP vocabulary snapshots stay comparable across releases.

text: many survey-level sanitation data points JMP release hold Uganda, source type? Safely managed sanitation Uganda time, modelled estimates:

title: jmpinput 0.1.0
text: First release jmpinput openwashdata R data package, converted former scripts--outputs repository. jmpraw: survey-level input data sanitation underlying /UNICEF JMP estimates (26,926 data points, JMP 2025 release, pulled 2026-08-20). jmpindicators: modelled JMP indicator estimates drinking water, sanitation hygiene (424,575 estimates, JMP 2025 release), variable codes normalized legacy JMP vocabulary. datasets documented data-raw/dictionary.csv downloadable inst/extdata/ (csv xlsx jmpraw, gzip csv jmpindicators). update pipeline, raw inputs, dated snapshots diff reports live data-raw/; see data-raw/UPDATING.md.
